title: US 52 over Mud Creek
source_note: 2020-03-27 Stage 3 · DRAFT / NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION · Exterior detail modeling candidate
assumptions: The public document is a design draft, not final as-built plans. This model reconstructs that drawing version. A separate 12-page scanned plan set for the existing bridge is available and is not mixed with the new design.
Internal reinforcing bars, tendons and embedded hardware are excluded. Fabrication details absent from the drawings are not claimed as reconstructed.
Colors distinguish components. Individual volumes may overlap at assembly boundaries and must not be summed as a quantity takeoff.
The default view hides the LMC overlay to expose 24 panels and their joints. Enable the overlay layer to view the finished surface.
Elevation 910.80 ft is assigned local vertical coordinate 0. The 135 ft vertical curve and +/-0.5% tangents are modeled parabolically.
Deck, railings and bedding layers are separate model components. Their descriptions identify actual monolithic or precast integration where known.

detail_coverage.detail: Spans 27 + 36 + 27 ft; deck 91 ft 6 in by 40 ft 4 in; 2% crossfall and 135 ft vertical curve.

Separately modeled 24 modules, 8 in longitudinal joints, 12 in transverse pier joints and 13 in abutment joints. Module length follows p39: 26 ft 2 in, distinguished from the p38 overview's 27 ft 3 in notation. Joint profiles and embedded pockets are simplified.
Includes 8 modules per pier with vertical UHPC, rounded wall ends, segmented abutments and 4 wingwalls. Internal pile pockets are shown as filled envelopes.
Each approach includes 6 panels and connections. FC railing sections are approximate; TFC transition curvature is omitted.
Internal reinforcement, pile lengths, embedded lifting devices, lane markings, continuous roadway and fine surface texture are excluded.

coordinate_system.native: X longitudinal / Y transverse / Z up; metres. Local datum described in assumptions.
